title: Hush Greaves
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, the hush plate flattened into leg armour.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now hammer a hush plate flat into greaves, chalk marrow packed into the seams to keep them quiet.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking chalk marrow, for anyone who would rather buy than dig it out of a chalk wretch.

items.name: Hush greaves
items.examine: Hush plate hammered flat and hinged at the knee. It does not so much as click when you walk.
